story: At Clásica de Almería, an early five-rider breakaway built a maximum lead of around 5:30 minutes before being controlled by Cofidis, NSN Cycling Team, and Unibet Rose Rockets. Multiple late crashes reduced the peloton, and Biniam Girmay won the sprint ahead of Fretin and Groenewegen.
